levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد بن الوليد

notes: the second group is the oath after the saying («قال عبد الحميد بن عواض ... لسمعت هذا الحديث من أبي جعفر»): another hearer named for the same saying, so a variant remark, never a route
the Imam after «سمعت» is the last link of the main route (ruling 2); the ZWNJ in «الْحَسَنِ بْنِ‌ أَبِي» is dropped from the surface
